The Future Care Conversation Checklist

What to ask, write down and come back to while your wife is well.

Download PDF

Your wife is well, and the subject of future care has never come up between you. This list is for raising it as a conversation about her life, with nothing to decide at the end of it. Check what you've done, in whatever order it happens. Anything unchecked is a conversation that hasn't happened yet, and says nothing about her or about you.

Ask

Write down

Come back to

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you ask, write down and come back. It doesn't say what her answers mean, whether anything should change, or what the family ought to decide. Nothing on it adds up to a score.

Ready for the next step?

You've asked, written down what was said, and marked what to come back to. The care interview adds the rest of your wife's situation, area by area, so her wishes sit beside a full account of how she lives now, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.
